_comment: Entitlement ratios for ratio-less NSE corporate actions, taken from issuer filings.
THIS FILE IS AN INPUT, NOT AN INFERENCE. NSE publishes demergers with no ratio, and the size
of the entitlement is a legal fact the issuer publishes -- not something recoverable from the
parent's ex-date gap. An earlier revision of the adjustment code derived ratios from that gap;
measured on the research universe it would have inferred an UPWARD correction for NMDC
(+71.0%), BAJAJELEC (+32.2%) and SCI (+30.0%), erasing genuine market moves and inventing fake
ones. Every entry here must therefore cite the filing it came from.
An action absent from this file is left UNRESOLVED by scripts/validate_demerger_factors.py, and
every feature window and label window spanning it is dropped downstream. That is the safe
default: losing a few dozen observations costs far less than publishing a fabricated return.
Adding an entry is not sufficient for the factor to be used. validate_demerger_factors.py also
checks value continuity against the RESULTING COMPANY'S OWN first traded price:
That is a second instrument's price, independent of the parent's gap. An entry whose ratio does
not balance that identity within 5% is refused, not applied.
Run scripts/validate_demerger_factors.py first; its worklist at
action with its ex-date gap, the same-day market median move, and candidate new listings, so a
human can look up the filing for the ones that matter.

entitlements.note: HEG Limited filing dated 2026-08-24 sets 2026-09-07 as the record date and specifies one HEG Graphite share for each eligible HEG share. EXPECTED TO REFUSE with RESULTING_COMPANY_NOT_IN_CACHE: the ex-date falls after this cache's window (received_end 2026-08-21) and HEG Graphite has no price in this repository at all. The refusal is the point -- it is what lets the XS-Monthly book disclose an unpriced entitlement instead of booking either the full -64.3% quote drop as a loss or an invented recovery. The issuer's own site returned HTTP 403 on direct retrieval; the reproduced filing text is the cited source and the ratio must be re-verified against the issuer's own disclosure before this entry is ever used to adjust anything. The resulting_symbol is a placeholder pending the actual NSE listing symbol.
